_comment: Florist (MoreVillagers). A trade in things that are useless and that everybody wants anyway.
The §12.4 anchors are the beds, seed, the seasons, weddings and funerals, a plant that will not
take and the customer who cannot say what they mean. These three take a bed that has failed, an
order for a funeral, and a variety she has been trying to grow for four years.
The florist's difficulty is that her work is mostly about other people's occasions. She is
practical about soil and careful about grief, and she is quietly firm that flowers are a real
trade rather than a decoration on one.
